A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Build computational methods and workflows that help scientists discover new medicines. We're building a massive, real-time conversational experience from the ground up, one that will reach users at Apple scale. That platform makes X trillion ad decisions every day and supports $XB+ in annual publisher revenue across XX+ Amazon-owned publishers and X,000+ external publishers in streaming TV, audio, display, mobile and podcasts. Every one of those decisions is a science problem: which inventory qualifies for which buyers, how publisher commitments are paced and delivered, which ad wins among competing candidates, and what price maximizes long-term yield. Each must be solved in milliseconds, under strict latency and cost budgets, while balancing advertisers, publishers, viewers and Amazon. At this scale, a fraction-of-a-percent model improvement is worth $X millions.
We are looking for a Principal Applied Scientist to set the science strategy for this platform. You will decide where machine learning creates the most value, bring intelligence into real-time runtime systems, and lead models from idea to production. Your work will directly shape three of Amazon Ads’ biggest priorities: growing Amazon-owned and third-party supply, enabling full-funnel advertising, and building agentic, AI-driven workflows for publishers and advertisers.
As a principal, you will be a technical leader across the organization. You will raise the science bar, mentor senior scientists, and influence product and engineering leaders. You will work alongside excellent, driven scientists, engineers and product leaders who take on hard problems and invest in each other’s growth. Few places in the world operate at this scale.

* Define the ML strategy for the ad decisioning platform. Set a multi-year science vision across pricing, yield optimization, forecasting, ad selection and commitment delivery, tied to measurable business outcomes. * Identify opportunities to deploy intelligence in runtime systems. Find where rules and heuristics in real-time serving paths can be replaced or improved by learned models, and partner with engineering to fit them within latency, compute and reliability budgets. * Build ML models that operate at X trillion decisions a day, drawing on approaches such as deep learning, reinforcement learning and bandits, causal inference, forecasting, and auction and mechanism design. * Evaluate ML models rigorously. item.description:
**About The Team** DoorDash is building the next generation of causal decisioning systems for New Verticals: grocery, convenience, retail, alcohol, pets, flowers, and other emerging categories. A central mandate is to define and build a durable company-level causal value metric: a trusted, long-term signal that estimates the incremental value created by product, growth, and marketplace actions. Create a roadmap that joins foundational platform work with high-value product applications. * Define the company-level causal value metric and its measurement framework, including the target construct, time horizon, component outcomes, identification strategy, calibration, uncertainty, and guardrails. * Build the metric into a decision system that teams can use for product prioritization, experiment readouts, intervention selection, budget allocation, and portfolio tradeoffs. * Establish how randomized experiments, quasi-experiments, observational estimation, and learned models work together.
